title: Lisbon Travel Guide — The Ultimate 5 Day Itinerary
description:
Just got back from 5 incredible days in Lisbon and I'm already planning my return trip 🇵🇹

Here's what we did:
✅ Alfama district — the oldest neighbourhood, stunning viewpoints
✅ Belém Tower right by the Tagus River
✅ Jerónimos Monastery — free entry on Sunday mornings!
✅ Sintra day trip — Pena Palace is absolutely magical
✅ Time Out Market for the best food hall in Europe
✅ LX Factory on a Sunday for vintage shopping
✅ Cascais beach town — easy day trip from Lisbon

Full blog post linked below! #lisbon #portugal #travel #europe
